import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars1 = ax1.bar(range(len(product_sales)), product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_sales)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_sales.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Add value labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars1):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top right)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([age for age in age_order if age in age_sales.index])
bars2 = ax2.bar(range(len(age_sales_ordered)), age_sales_ordered.values, 
                color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(age_sales_ordered)))
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_sales_ordered)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_sales_ordered.index, fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Add value labels
for i, bar in enumerate(bars2):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Bottom left)
payment_counts = df.groupby('payment_method').size()
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(payment_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales and Count (Bottom right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'product': 'count'})
takeaway_data.index = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']

x = np.arange(len(takeaway_data.index))
width = 0.35

ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
bars_sales = ax4.bar(x - width/2, takeaway_data['total'], width, 
                     label='Total Sales ($)', color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.8)
bars_count = ax4_twin.bar(x + width/2, takeaway_data['product'], width,
                          label='Transaction Count', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#2ecc71')
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Transaction Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#3498db')
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(takeaway_data.index, fontsize=11)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2ecc71')
ax4_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')

# Add value labels
for i, bar in enumerate(bars_sales):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars_count):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4_twin.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                  f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Combine legends
lines1, labels1 = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax4_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', fontsize=10)

ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
